items.chinese: 紅葡萄酒 / 白葡萄酒
items.note: Many people prefer red wine with beef and white wine with fish.（很多人喜歡吃牛肉時配紅葡萄酒，吃魚時配白葡萄酒。）
She sprayed a little perfume on her wrist before going out.（她出門前在手腕上噴了一點香水。）
The new coffee machine is highly efficient and can make ten cups in two minutes.（這台新咖啡機效率很高，可以在兩分鐘內做十杯。）
Moderate exercise every day is good for your health.（每天適度運動對身體有益。）

items.chinese: 過度飲用、暴飲暴食，沉溺
items.note: It is easy to overindulge in sweet desserts during holidays.（節假日期間人們很容易暴飲暴食甜點。）
One third of the cake was left after the party.（派對結束後還剩下三分之一的蛋糕。）
He sat by the window and slowly sip his hot coffee.（他坐在窗邊慢慢地喝著熱咖啡。）
Wine drinkers like to swirl the glass before smelling the wine.（品酒者喜歡在聞酒香前先輕搖酒杯。）
She took a quick sniff of the soup to see if it was fresh.（她湊近聞了一下湯，看看是否新鮮。）

items.chinese: 瓦波利切拉（意大利葡萄酒/產區名）
items.note: Valpolicella is a popular Italian red wine that goes great with pasta.（瓦波利切拉是一款很受歡迎的意大利紅酒，和意面很配。）
This dark chocolate has a complex flavour profile with fruity and nutty notes.（這款黑巧克力有著複雜的風貌輪廓，帶有果香和堅果香。）
Add some black pepper to the soup for a better taste.（在湯裡加點黑胡椒味道會更好。）
Eating a handful of almonds is a healthy snack choice.（吃一把杏仁是健康的零食選擇。）
Many people love to sprinkle cinnamon on top of their coffee.（很多人喜歡在咖啡上撒肉桂粉。）
This bakery makes chocolate cookies filled with nuts.（這家麵包房製作夾有堅果的巧克力餅乾。）
This white wine has a nice fresh acidity, so it does not taste too sour.（這款白葡萄酒酸度清新，因此嚐起來不會太酸。）

items.chinese: 酒体（醇厚度） // 清淡酒體 / 飽滿酒體
items.note: If you like thick and strong drinks, choose a full-bodied red wine.（如果你喜歡濃郁厚重的飲料，就選酒體飽滿的紅葡萄酒。）

items.chinese: 單寧 / 柔和單寧 / 緊實單寧
items.note: The red wine has smooth tannins, making it very easy to drink.（這款紅酒單寧柔和，非常容易入口。）

items.chinese: 干度（無甜度） / 半干型（微甜）
items.note: If you do not like completely dry wines, try an off-dry white wine instead.（如果你不喜歡完全不甜的酒，可以試試半干型白葡萄酒。）

items.chinese: 年輕款（新酒） / 陳年款（老酒）
items.note: Young wines taste fresh, but aged wines usually smell more complex.（新酒喝起來新鮮，但陳年酒聞起來通常更複雜。）
Unripe bananas and strong tea often leave an astringent feeling on your tongue.（沒熟透的香蕉和濃茶常在舌頭上留下澀感。）

items.chinese: 容量，體積 / 志願者（注意兩者發音區分）
items.note: Check the volume on the bottle to see how much water is inside.（查看瓶子上的容量，看看裡面有多少水。）

items.english: top note / middle note / base note / finish
items.chinese: 前調 / 中調 / 底調 / 尾調（後味）
items.note: This wine has a fresh citrus top note and a very long, pleasant finish.（這款葡萄酒帶有清新的柑橘前調，並帶有非常悠長舒適的尾調。）
Chinese liquor is usually served in small glasses during big celebrations.（中國白酒通常在重大慶祝活動中用小杯飲用。）
Would you like a glass of white wine with your seafood dinner?（你吃海鮮晚餐時想來一杯白葡萄酒嗎？）
Walking alone in the quiet mountains gave her a wonderful feeling of liberty.（獨自在安靜的山間行走給了她一種美好的自在感。）
Resistance exercise helps build strong muscles and bones as you get older.（隨著年齡增長，抗阻訓練有助於強健肌肉和骨骼。）
Many Asian people enjoy drinking warm soya milk for breakfast.（許多亞洲人喜歡在早餐時喝熱豆漿。）
Over the past few years, more people have started working from home.（在過去的幾年裡，更多的人開始居家辦公。）

items.chinese: 心理健康 / 精神層面地 / 身體層面地
items.note: Yoga helps people stay healthy both mentally and physically.（瑜伽有助於人們在精神和身體層面都保持健康。）
Eating foods with a low glycemic index helps control your energy throughout the day.（食用低升糖指數的食物有助於全天控制能量。）
Vegetables and whole grains are rich in dietary fibre.（蔬菜和全谷物富含膳食纖維。）
She spent most of her happy childhood living in a quiet village.（她的快樂童年大部分時間是在一個安靜的小村莊度過的。）
This old restaurant is famous for keeping the traditional flavour of soup noodles.（這家老店以保留湯麵的傳統風味而聞名。）

items.english: dark roast coffee bean / medium roast / light roast
items.chinese: 深烘咖啡豆 / 中烘 / 淺烘
items.note: Dark roast coffee beans give your morning drink a strong, bold taste.（深烘咖啡豆能為你的晨間咖啡帶來濃郁強烈的口感。）

items.chinese: 化學；（人與人之間的）化學反應/默契
items.note: Cooking food involves a lot of interesting simple chemistry.（烹飪食物包含許多有趣且簡單的化學反應。）
The fresh fragrance of wild flowers filled the whole garden.（野花的清新香氣充滿了整個花園。）
Dark chocolate can taste a bit bitter if you are used to milk chocolate.（如果你習慣了牛奶巧克力，黑巧克力嚐起來可能會有點苦。）

items.english: leave / typhoon leave / ask for leave
items.chinese: 假期，休假 / 颱風假 / 請假
items.note: I felt very sick this morning, so I had to ask for leave and stayed in bed.（今天早上我病得很厲害，所以我必須請假並躺在床上休息。）
She looked at the public holiday calendar to plan her autumn trip with her partner.（她看了看節假日日曆，以便和伴侶規劃他們的秋季旅行。）
Extreme weather has caused more natural disasters around the world in recent years.（近年來，極端天氣在世界各地引發了更多的自然災害。）

items.chinese: 龍捲風 / 洪水 / 地震 / 颱風
items.note: After the earthquake, the government quickly sent food and water to the damaged towns.（地震發生後，政府迅速向受災城鎮運送了食物和水。）
Eating fresh vegetables and fruits is an easy way to get enough vitamins.（多吃新鮮蔬菜和水果是攝取足夠維生素的簡單方法。）
Having too much caffeine in the afternoon might make it hard for you to sleep at night.（下午攝入過多咖啡因可能會讓你晚上很難入睡。）
To stay healthy, you should not drink too much alcohol before going to bed.（為了保持健康，你不應該在睡前喝太多酒。）
Drinking moderate amounts of tea can be very good for your stomach.（喝適量的茶對你的胃很有好處。）
Skipping breakfast can make you feel tired and hungry by midday.（不吃早餐會讓你到中午時感到疲倦和飢餓。）
Eating too many fatty foods is not good for your heart.（吃太多高脂肪食物對心臟不好。）

items.chinese: 氣泡飲料，汽水 / 蘇打
items.note: I prefer plain water because fizzy drinks contain too much sugar.（我更喜歡喝純水，因為汽水含有太多糖分。）
We ordered two sweet cocktails with lime and mint at the beach bar.（我們在海灘酒吧點了兩杯帶有青檸和薄荷的甜雞尾酒。）
My flatmate and I take it in turns to clean the shared kitchen every weekend.（我和室友每個週末輪流打掃共用的廚房。）
During the Chinese New Year, playing mahjong is a fun way to spend time with relatives.（在農曆新年期間，打麻將是與親戚共度時光的有趣方式。）
Driving electric cars instead of petrol cars is a great way to reduce air pollution.（開電動車代替汽油車是減少空氣污染的好方法。）
I don't need to drive to work because I can take the company bus every morning.（我不需要開車上班，因為我每天早上都可以搭公司班車。）

items.chinese: 泥土（自然土壤） / 灰塵，浮塵 / 污垢，髒土
items.note: She bought some fresh soil to plant flowers in her balcony garden.（她買了一些新鮮泥土，準備在陽台花園裡種花。）

items.chinese: 緊繃的，緊張的 / 高強度的，強烈的 / 焦慮的，憂慮的
items.note: Her shoulders felt very tense after sitting at her desk for eight hours.（在辦公桌前坐了八個小時後，她的肩膀感覺非常緊繃。）

items.chinese: 蘇打汽水 / 無糖可樂
items.note: Since she is trying to cut down on sugar, she always orders sugar-free cola.（因為她正試圖減少糖分攝入，所以她總是點無糖可樂。）

items.chinese: 薯片；薯條（英式） / 炸薯條（美式）
items.note: In London, they serve hot fish and chips with salt and vinegar.（在倫敦，他們提供搭配鹽和醋的熱魚和薯條。）
I forgot my umbrella and got completely wet in the sudden afternoon thunderstorm.（我忘了帶傘，在突如其來的午後雷陣雨中全身都淋濕了。）
If it rains tomorrow, I will just run on the treadmill in the gym.（如果明天下雨，我原打算去戶外跑步就改成去健身房跑跑步機。）
Lemon juice is very useful for washing away the fishy odour from your hands after cooking seafood.（煮完海鮮後，檸檬汁對於洗掉手上的海鮮腥味非常有用。）
Every member of staff at our school attended the meeting yesterday.（我們學校的每位員工昨天都參加了會議。）
During the brainstorming session, Sarah came up with some brand-new thoughts for our new English course.（在腦力激盪會議中，莎拉為我們的新英語課程想出了一些全新的想法。）
It is hard to work with a boss who has endless changes of opinion about the project layout.（與一個對專案規劃有無休止意見變更的老闆一起工作是很困難的。）
I saw Tom argue with his partner about where to go for the summer holiday.（我看到湯姆和他的伴侶為了暑假去哪裡玩而爭吵。）
Instead of complaining about the system error, we should focus on finding solutions.（與其抱怨系統錯誤，我們應該專注於尋找解決辦法。）
After a two-hour meeting, the team finally reached a conclusion about the new textbook structure.（經過兩個小時的會議，團隊終於對新教科書的結構得出了結論。）
Your presentation is too long; you just need to highlight the core points.（你的簡報太長了；你只需要強調核心觀點即可。）
Once we lock down the overall structure of the syllabus, we can start writing the details of each unit.（一旦我們敲定了教學大綱的整體框架，就可以開始撰寫每個單元的細節。）
I need to edit the PowerPoint slides and images before presenting to the manager tomorrow morning.（在明天早上向經理做簡報之前，我需要編輯好PPT的投影片和圖片。）
The report is too wordy; we should cut down on information to make it easier to read.（這份報告太囉唆了；我們應該精簡信息以使其更容易閱讀。）
At the end of the lesson, the teacher asked us to write a summary of the story we just read.（課程結束時，老師要求我們對剛剛讀過的故事做一個總結。）
The CEO gave a company-wide presentation about the new office policies this morning.（執行長今天早上做了一個關於新辦公室政策的面向全公司的彙報。）
We need to cooperate closely with our external partners to run this online course successfully.（我們需要與外部合作方緊密合作，才能成功營運這個線上課程。）

items.english: hand a project over to sb
items.note: Before Alice left for her vacation, she handed the project over to me.（在愛麗絲請假去度假之前，她把項目交給了我負責。）
Since we have done similar projects before, this new task should be quite easy for us.（既然我們以前做過類似項目，這項新任務對我們來說應該挺容易的。）
My partner goes swimming and plays pickleball twice a week to keep fit.（我的伴侶每週去游泳和打皮克球兩次以保持身材勻稱。）
This intensive weekend course doesn't really suit students who prefer to learn slowly.（這個密集的週末課程並不太適合更喜歡慢節奏學習的學生。）

items.chinese: 好身材 / 線條緊緻的身材
items.note: He goes to the gym four times a week to keep a good physique.（他每週上健身房四次，以維持好身材。）
If you want to lose weight, you might want to eat fewer carbs like white bread and white rice.（如果你想減肥，你可能需要少吃一些像白麵包和白米飯這樣的高碳水食物。）
She decided to go on a diet before summer because she wanted to fit into her favorite dress.（她決定在夏天之前開始控制飲食，因為她想穿下她最喜歡的洋裝。）

items.chinese: 攝入卡路里 / 消耗卡路里
items.note: If you consume more calories than you burn, you will gain weight.（如果你攝入的卡路里比消耗的卡路里多，你就會變胖。）
This bubble tea shop allows you to choose from four different tea bases, including Oolong and Jasmine green tea.（這家奶茶店允許你從四種不同的茶底中進行選擇，包括烏龍茶和茉莉綠茶。）
Buying a cold hand-shaken bubble tea is a perfect way to cool down on a scorching summer afternoon.（在酷熱的夏日午後，買一杯冰涼的手搖奶茶是消暑的完美方式。）
I love the tapioca pearls in this drink because they have a very nice, chewy texture.（我非常喜歡這款飲料裡的木薯珍珠，因為它們有一種非常好、有嚼勁的口感。）
To make authentic boba pearls at home, you must buy high-quality tapioca starch.（想在家裡製作道地的波霸珍珠，你必須購買高品質的木薯粉。）
Regular soda and hand-shaken milk teas are usually very high in sugar, so I always ask for "no sugar".（普通的汽水和手搖奶茶通常糖分很高，所以我總是要求「不加糖」。）
There are three different convenience stores right outside our school gates, which is very handy.（我們學校大門外就有三家不同的便利店，這非常方便。）
Parents usually prefer to buy snacks that do not contain any artificial additives for their children.（家長通常更傾向於為孩子購買不含任何人工添加劑的零食。）
This tea shop became famous because it uses award-winning tea blends as its secret ingredient.（這家茶飲店之所以出名，是因為它使用獲獎茶品作為其秘密配方。）
Ready-to-drink beverages are very popular among busy office workers who don't have time to wait in line.（即飲飲品在沒有時間排隊的忙碌上班族中非常受歡迎。）
According to our new company travel policy, employees must book economy class flights for short trips.（根據我們公司新的差旅政策，員工在短途旅行時必須預訂經濟艙機票。）
Mooncakes are a famous traditional food that Chinese people eat during the Mid-Autumn Festival.（月餅是中國人在中秋節期間食用的一種著名的傳統美食。）
She has a typical Virgo personality, always paying great attention to details and focusing on high-end aesthetic designs.（她有典型的處女座性格，總是非常注重細節，並講究高質感的美學設計。）
According to the astrology magazine, people born under Gemini are usually very communicative, highly adaptable, and full of wit.（根據星座雜誌，雙子座的人通常很健談、適應力強，而且機智風趣。）

items.chinese: 星座、黃道帶 / 星座標誌
items.note: Before planning their holiday or analyzing their relationship fortune, they love to check their Western zodiac signs and Eastern Bazi elements.（在規劃假期或分析感情運勢之前，他們喜歡查看西方星座和東方八字五行。）
There is a common stereotype that all English language teachers are incredibly strict, but she proves that educators can be very supportive and grounded.（一般人常有刻板印象，認為英文老師都非常嚴格，但她證明了教育者也可以很支持學生又務實。）
In modern relationships, being overly controlling can damage mutual trust, so it is important to give each other enough private space.（在現代的感情關係中，控制欲太強會破壞彼此的信任，所以給對方足夠的私人空間很重要。）

items.chinese: 愛整潔、把每樣東西收拾得乾乾淨淨
items.note: She prefers a minimalist lifestyle, always working hard to keep everything tidy and clean on her professional desk.（她偏好極簡的生活方式，總是努力讓辦公桌上的一切保持整齊乾淨。）
For freelance educators, delivering a high-quality online presentation is an excellent way to attract potential clients.（對自由接案的教育工作者來說，做一場高品質的線上簡報是吸引潛在客戶的好方法。）
After deep negotiations regarding the teaching modules, the two training centers finally decided to sign a contract.（經過對教學模組的深入協商，兩家培訓中心終於決定簽約。）
She values professional ethics deeply, which makes her a highly trusted business partner in the local educational industry.（她非常重視職業道德，因此成為當地教育界備受信賴的事業夥伴。）
Achieving a score of 7.5 on the IELTS exam can open up amazing career opportunities if you want to apply for a management role in a foreign company.（如果你想應徵外商公司的管理職，雅思考到 7.5 分能為你打開很棒的職涯機會。）
Your extensive experience in TESOL perfectly matches the qualifications needed for this distance learning master's program.（你豐富的 TESOL 經驗完全符合這個遠距碩士課程所需的資格。）

items.chinese: 全職工作 / 兼職工作
items.note: Although her main job is teaching English at a language school, she also takes on freelance consulting as a satisfying part-time job.（雖然她的正職是在語言學校教英文，她也接自由顧問工作，當作很有成就感的兼職。）

items.chinese: 居家辦公、遠程辦公（常縮寫為 WFH）
items.note: Operating a freelance education business gives her the absolute freedom to work from home and manage her own curriculum schedule.（經營自由接案的教育事業，讓她能完全自由地在家工作，並自己安排課程時間。）

items.chinese: 提升、改善、提高（常用於技能、語言、能力）
items.note: She designed a special vocabulary tracking system to help her A2-level students improve their language proficiency faster.（她設計了一套特別的單字追蹤系統，幫助 A2 程度的學生更快提升語言能力。）

items.chinese: 增長、增加（常用於數量、數字、比例）
items.note: The main purpose of this mock test strategy is to increase the number of correct answers in the IELTS reading section.（這個模擬考策略的主要目的，是增加雅思閱讀部分的答對題數。）

items.chinese: 適合的、適宜的（可完美替代 fit）
items.note: This analytical reading textbook is highly suitable for students who are preparing for advanced post-graduate qualifications.（這本分析性閱讀教材非常適合正在準備研究所進階資格的學生。）
While she delivers her presentations in professional British English, her native language is standard Mandarin.（雖然她用專業的英式英語做簡報，她的母語是標準普通話。）
At the beginning of the term, some students had a strong local accent, but they quickly improved after listening to standard audio inputs.（學期初有些學生的地方口音很重，但聽了標準音檔之後很快就進步了。）
Her ultimate goal is to help her students not only pass the IELTS exam but also communicate fluently in a professional British environment.（她的終極目標是幫助學生不只通過雅思考試，還能在專業的英國環境中流利溝通。）
When teaching grammar modules, it is essential to explain how the comparative form differs from the superlative form.（教文法單元時，一定要解釋比較級和最高級的差別。）
To improve your speaking output, you must first accumulate a large amount of high-quality reading and listening input.（想提升口說輸出，你必須先累積大量高品質的閱讀和聽力輸入。）
Understanding educational psychology can help teachers design better motivation strategies for students during their learning plateaus.（了解教育心理學，能幫助老師在學生遇到學習停滯期時設計更好的激勵策略。）
She regularly reads advanced magazines to keep up with global financial trends and economic updates.（她定期閱讀進階雜誌，以掌握全球金融趨勢和經濟動態。）
Her teaching philosophy focuses on inspiring students' critical thinking rather than making them memorise phrases mechanically.（她的教學理念著重於啟發學生的批判性思考，而不是讓他們死背片語。）
The analytical report in The Economist provides deep insights into how geopolitical events affect the global stock market.（《經濟學人》的分析報導深入剖析了地緣政治事件如何影響全球股市。）
The premium boutique hotel uses high-aesthetic vintage portraits to attract sophisticated travelers.（這間高級精品旅館用極具美感的復古肖像畫來吸引品味講究的旅客。）
Instead of digital articles, she prefers reading physical copies of analytical magazines during her weekend coffee time.（比起數位文章，她更喜歡在週末喝咖啡時閱讀紙本的分析性雜誌。）
Reading The Economist regularly is an excellent way for advanced students to build sophisticated vocabulary for the IELTS reading test.（對進階學生來說，定期閱讀《經濟學人》是為雅思閱讀累積高階詞彙的好方法。）
Seeing her students overcome their learning plateaus and speak English fluently gives her a strong sense of achievement.（看到學生突破學習停滯期、流利地說英文，讓她很有成就感。）
Saying "I have a million things to do today" is a classic example of hyperbole that we use frequently in daily spoken English.（說「我今天有一百萬件事要做」是日常英文口語中常用的誇飾法典型例子。）
Freelance educators usually require their graduate school applicants to hand in their personal statements before the weekend deadline.（自由接案的教育工作者通常會要求申請研究所的學生在週末截止前交出個人陳述。）

items.chinese: 開展合作、建立合作關係
items.note: The local training center managed to strike up cooperation with a premium distance learning institution in the UK.（這家本地培訓中心成功與英國一所優質遠距教學機構建立合作。）
We were ready to sign the contract, but unfortunately, the entire business deal fell through at the last minute due to financial disagreements.（我們本來準備好要簽約了，但很可惜，整筆交易在最後一刻因財務上的分歧而告吹。）

items.chinese: 沉浸式閱讀、把自己埋首於閱讀中
items.note: On a rainy weekend afternoon, she loves to sit in a quiet armchair with a cup of hot latte and completely immerse herself in reading Peter Hessler's latest book.（在下雨的週末午後，她喜歡坐在安靜的扶手椅上，配一杯熱拿鐵，完全沉浸在何偉（Peter Hessler）的新書裡。）
I keep a healthy daily routine every weekday.（我平日維持規律的日常作息。）
The heavy workload makes me feel tired easily.（龐大的工作量讓我容易感到疲累。）
My workstation is near the office window.（我的工位靠近辦公室窗邊。）
I need to wrap up daily tasks before getting off work.（我下班前必須收尾日常工作。）
Please elaborate your opinions in the meeting.（請在會議中詳細闡述你的看法。）
I will make a work presentation this Friday.（這週五我要進行工作匯報。）
Strict rules make new staff feel threatened.（嚴格的制度讓新人感到備受威脅。）
He is good at getting along with his subordinates.（他善於和下屬相處。）
Too many trivial tasks waste my working time.（過多瑣碎雜事耗費我的工作時間。）
Long meetings will drain energy quickly.（長時間開會會快速消耗精力。）
Good cross-rank communication helps work go smoothly.（良好的跨層級溝通有助工作順利進行。）
I can take independent charge of this new project.（我能夠獨立負責這項新專案。）
Please do not disturb me when I am busy working.（我忙於工作時請不要打擾我。）
We need to negotiate about the working time.（我們需要針對工作時間進行溝通協商。）
This is just a superficial idea without deep thinking.（這只是淺顯表面、未經深思的想法。）
She still keeps full passion for her job.（她依舊對工作滿懷熱忱。）
Proper rest can raise working enthusiasm.（適當休息能提升工作積極性。）
I feel exhausted after finishing all the work.（完成所有工作後我身心俱疲。）
Some small companies will have layoffs in off-seasons.（部分小公司淡季會進行裁員。）
Long repeated work leads to career stagnation.（長期重複工作會造成職涯停滯不前。）
This channel has more than ten thousand subscribers.（這個頻道擁有上萬名訂閱用戶。）
Many graduates come to apply for vacant positions.（許多畢業生前來應聘空缺崗位。）
Finishing hard tasks brings great achievement.（完成困難任務能帶來滿滿成就感。）
Design work needs rich creativity very much.（設計類工作十分需要豐富創造力。）
As an introvert, I like working alone.（身為內向的人，我喜歡獨自工作。）
Most sales staff are typical extroverts.（多數業務人員都是典型外向的人。）
Unique work ideas can attract attention quickly.（獨特的工作想法能快速吸引注意力。）
We should learn to reject unreasonable requests.（我們要學會拒絕不合理的要求。）
He is a talented young worker in the team.（他是團隊裡有才幹的年輕員工。）
I accidentally knew his working plan.（我無意間得知了他的工作計畫。）
This position has a strict fixed quota.（這個職位有嚴格的固定名額。）
Many people want to escape from busy work.（許多人想要逃離繁忙的工作。）

items.english: on purpose / intend to do sth
items.note: She didn't make mistakes on purpose.（她並非故意犯下錯誤。）
The company will eliminate low-efficiency workers.（公司將淘汰效率低下的員工。）
He hurt his jawbone when he fell off his bike.（他從腳踏車上摔下來時傷到了下顎骨。）
The doctor checked my mandible for any damage.（醫生檢查了我的下顎骨是否有損傷。）
Stress can cause pain in the temporomandibular joint.（壓力可能導致顳顎關節疼痛。）
We have a holiday on International Workers’ Day.（國際勞動節我們會放假。）
Many people feel tired in a competitive work culture.（很多人在競爭激烈的工作文化中感到疲憊。）
Frequent tiredness is a health warning.（經常疲倦是一種健康警訊。）
I am planning my annual leave for May.（我正在規劃五月的年假。）
He has an active mind and never stops thinking.（他思緒活躍，總是不停思考。）
The shop serves many customers, while the lawyer has clients.（這家店有很多顧客，而律師擁有專屬客戶。）
They have very different personalities.（他們的性格截然不同。）
A moderate level of exercise is good for health.（適度的運動對健康有益。）
She can get things done quickly without mistakes.（她能快速又不出錯地把事情做完。）

items.chinese: procrastinator 拖延者；planner 規劃者
items.note: I am a planner, but my brother is a procrastinator.（我是個會規劃的人，但我弟弟很愛拖延。）

items.chinese: 全神貫注的；深陷其中的
items.note: He is deeply involved in his new project.（他全心投入在新專案上。）
It’s easy to immerse yourself in work and forget time.（人很容易沉浸工作而忘記時間。）
You can ask for an extension on your course.（你可以申請課程有效期延長。）
The validity of the course is one year.（這門課的有效期為一年。）
There is a contradiction between his words and actions.（他的言行互相矛盾。）
We have conflicting plans for the weekend.（我們週末的計畫互相衝突。）
My cheek feels painful after sleeping badly.（我沒睡好，臉頰覺得痛。）
My time after work is very limited.（我下班後的時間非常有限。）

items.chinese: 日常作息；每日例行公事
items.note: I need to change my daily routine to get more rest.（我需要調整日常作息來多休息。）
After “want”, we use the infinitive.（want 後面要接不定詞。）

items.chinese: 只能接 V-ing 的動詞
items.note: I avoid walking alone at night.（我避免晚上獨自行走。）

items.chinese: 可接 to do / doing 的動詞（討厭/喜愛）
items.note: I love listening to music. = I love to listen to music.（我喜歡聽音樂。（兩種說法意思相同））

items.english: seem / would like / choose / decide / hope
items.chinese: 只能接 to do 的動詞
items.note: I hope to see you soon.（希望很快能見到你。）

items.chinese: 動詞句式 / 動詞型態
items.note: You need to learn which verb pattern to use after "avoid."（你需要學習在 "avoid" 之後使用哪種動詞句式。）
Planting trees can help reduce carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.（種樹有助於減少大氣中的二氧化碳。）
The server room must be kept at 20 degrees Celsius.（機房必須保持在攝氏 20 度。）
I was awake all night because of a mosquito in my room.（因為房間裡有一隻蚊子，我整晚都沒睡。）
Turn on the air conditioner; it's too hot in here.（開冷氣吧，這裡太熱了。）
The weather in Wuhan is very humid during the summer months.（武漢夏天的天氣非常潮濕。）
He felt frustrated when the software kept crashing.（當軟體不斷當機時，他感到很挫敗。）
The strike disrupted the city’s public transport system.（罷工擾亂了城市的公共交通系統。）
Reading more books will help you express yourself smoothly in English.（多讀書會幫助你用英文流利地表達自己。）
You should avoid using the same password for every website.（你應該避免在每個網站都使用相同的密碼。）
Do you enjoy gardening in your spare time?（你喜歡在閒暇時間從事園藝嗎？）
"On time" is a fixed phrase that means not late.（"On time" 是個固定短語，意思是準時。）
The stadium has a capacity of 50,000 people.（這座體育場可容納五萬人。）
Phrasal verbs are a common type of verb combination.（短語動詞是一種常見的動詞組合。）
It’s hard to choose (v.) when there are so many good choices (n.).（有這麼多好的選擇時，很難做出決定。）
Extract means to pull something out; ex-wife means a former wife.（Extract 是拔出；ex-wife 是前妻。）
He has excellent English pronunciation.（他的英文發音非常好。）

items.chinese: 預期 / 專家 / 提取
items.note: We expect an expert to extract the data from the broken drive.（我們預期會有一位專家從壞掉的硬碟中提取數據。）
The tech company had to lay off 200 workers this month.（這間科技公司這個月不得不裁員 200 人。）
Tencent is one of the largest technology companies in the world.（騰訊是全球最大的科技公司之一。）
This color combination looks very professional.（這個顏色組合看起來非常專業。）
Taking on another project will significantly increase my workload.（接手另一個專案會顯著增加我的工作量。）
Finishing the task gives me a strong sense of achievement.（完成這項任務讓我很有成就感。）

items.chinese: 失眠 / 睡眠品質不佳
items.note: My insomnia can be attributed to the high stress levels I've experienced since starting my master's degree.（我的失眠可以歸因於自從開始攻讀碩士學位以來所經歷的高壓力水平。）

items.english: Have a nosebleed / Stop the bleeding
items.note: When you have a nosebleed, lean forward and pinch your nose to stop the bleeding.（流鼻血時，身體前傾並捏住鼻子來止血。）
Establishing a nightly ritual to wind down is essential for those who struggle to unwind after a busy day in the city.（對於那些在城市忙碌一天後難以放鬆的人來說，建立每晚放鬆的儀式是必不可少的。）
Writing things down before bed helps to externalize your worries, making it easier to fall asleep.（睡前把事情記下來有助於將你的擔憂外化，讓你更容易入睡。）
To master the art of traveling light, one must prioritize versatile clothing and multi-purpose items.（要掌握輕裝旅行的藝術，必須優先考慮多功能衣物和多用途物品。）
I prefer to stow a cabin bag in the overhead bin to avoid the long wait for checked suitcases.（我更喜歡將登機包放在頭頂置物箱中，以避免長時間等待託運行李。）
Strategic travelers always allocate extra space for souvenirs when packing for an international trip.（有策略的旅行者在為國際旅行打包時，總是會預留額外的紀念品空間。）
Travelers visiting Africa often hope to encounter wild animals while exploring the continent's most wild places.（前往非洲旅遊的遊客，通常希望在探索該大陸最原始的荒野時與野生動物偶遇。）
Many people apply feng shui principles to their homes to create a more peaceful living environment.（許多人在家中應用風水原則，以創造一個更平靜的居住環境。）
The interpretation of the eight characters can provide insights into a person's elemental strengths and weaknesses.（對生辰八字的解讀可以深入了解一個人五行能量的強項與弱點。）
When faced with a difficult choice, analyzing the pros and cons helps you make an informed choice.（當面臨艱難抉擇時，分析利弊有助於你做出明智的選擇。）
We should heed the warning signs of burnout and take time to rest before it's too late.（我們應該聽從過度勞累的警告訊號，在為時已晚之前抽時間休息。）
Cultivating cat grass is a simple way to provide your pet with necessary nutrients at home.（在家中栽種貓草是為寵物提供必要營養的一種簡單方法。）

items.chinese: 課程開始之前的那段時間。
items.note: Please make sure you have all your materials ready before the class.（請確認上課前已準備好所有資料。）

items.chinese: 長度為兩個半小時的一段時間。
items.note: The workshop will last approximately two and a half hours.（這場工作坊大約會進行兩個半小時。）

items.chinese: 長期或季節性積水的土地，如沼澤、濕原等生態環境。
items.note: Wetlands play an essential role in filtering water and supporting wildlife.（濕地在淨化水質和維持野生動物生存上扮演重要角色。）

items.chinese: 位於日本關西地區的重要城市與經濟中心。
items.note: Osaka is famous for its lively food scene and friendly locals.（大阪以熱鬧的美食文化和友善的當地人聞名。）

items.chinese: 可能威脅安全、隱私或穩定的人、狀況或因素。
items.note: Some places are not safe to visit because of a high security risk.（有些地方因為安全風險高，不適合前往。）

items.chinese: 坐在或躺在陽光下休閒或曬黑。
items.note: We spent the afternoon sunbathing by the pool.（我們整個下午都在泳池邊曬太陽。）

items.chinese: 極度炎熱、灼熱的，尤指天氣或陽光。
items.note: You must wear sunscreen in this scorching heat.（在這麼炙熱的天氣裡，你一定要擦防曬。）

items.chinese: 一個人的頭髮被修剪、造型或整理的樣式。
items.note: Her new hairstyle suits her really well.（她的新髮型非常適合她。）

items.chinese: 剪一個新的、不同的髮型。
items.note: I’m thinking of getting a new haircut before the holiday.（我在考慮放假前去剪個新髮型。）
Their house is far away from the noise of the city.（他們的房子遠離城市的喧囂。）

items.chinese: 關於兩地或兩人之間的長距離。
items.note: Long-distance travel can be tiring but very rewarding.（長途旅行可能很累，但收穫很多。）

items.chinese: 以防水布料製成、用於露營的可攜式遮蔽物。
items.note: We set up our tent near the lake before dark.（我們在天黑前於湖邊搭好帳篷。）

items.chinese: 伴隨強風、大雨、雷鳴或閃電的天氣。
items.note: The flight was cancelled due to stormy weather.（班機因暴風雨天氣而取消。）

items.chinese: 因地殼運動引發的地面突然震動。
items.note: You should know what to do during an earthquake.（你應該知道地震時該怎麼做。）

items.chinese: 為特定用途提供的建築、服務或設施。
items.note: The hotel offers excellent fitness and swimming facilities.（這間飯店提供很棒的健身和游泳設施。）

items.chinese: 一個國家或地區運作所需的基礎系統，如交通、能源、水利、道路。
items.note: Investment in infrastructure supports economic growth.（投資基礎建設有助於經濟成長。）

items.chinese: 從事特定活動所需的工具、機器或物品。
items.note: All equipment must be checked before use.（所有設備在使用前都必須檢查。）

items.chinese: 有開口能噴發岩漿、灰燼與氣體的山。
items.note: The island has several active volcanoes.（這座島上有好幾座活火山。）

items.chinese: 火山突然噴發岩漿、灰燼與氣體的現象。
items.note: The volcanic eruption caused serious damage nearby.（火山爆發對附近地區造成嚴重破壞。）

items.chinese: 極度寒冷，常冷到足以結冰。
items.note: Wear a warm coat — it’s freezing outside.（穿件保暖的外套，外面冷得要命。）

items.chinese: 有把手、壺嘴與壺蓋，用來泡茶與倒茶的容器。
items.note: She poured hot tea from the teapot into the cups.（她把茶壺裡的熱茶倒進杯子裡。）

items.chinese: 造訪某地著名或有趣景點的活動。
items.note: We spent the whole day sightseeing in the old town.（我們花了一整天在老城區觀光。）

items.chinese: 含硫磺、有特殊氣味且具放鬆效果的天然溫泉。
items.note: Japan is famous for its natural sulphur hot springs.（日本以天然硫磺溫泉聞名。）

items.chinese: 富含天然礦物質、有益健康與放鬆的溫泉。
items.note: Many people visit mineral hot springs to relax.（很多人去礦物溫泉放鬆身心。）

items.chinese: 位於亞洲東南部的區域，包括中國以南、印度以東、澳洲以北的多個國家。
items.note: Southeast Asia is famous for its beaches and culture.（東南亞以海灘和文化聞名。）

items.chinese: 給 6 到 11 歲左右兒童就讀的學校，為義務教育的第一階段。
items.note: I started learning English in elementary school.（我從小學開始學英文。）

items.chinese: 在飯店、公司或醫院負責接待訪客、提供協助的工作人員。
items.note: The receptionist gave me my room key.（櫃檯人員把房間鑰匙交給我。）

items.chinese: 被聯合國教科文組織認定，對全人類具有特殊文化價值的地點或古蹟。
items.note: Many temples are listed as world cultural heritage.（許多寺廟被列為世界文化遺產。）

items.chinese: 法國知名餐廳評鑑指南，以星級評定餐廳品質。
items.note: We ate at a Michelin‑starred restaurant in Paris.（我們在巴黎一家米其林星級餐廳用餐。）

items.chinese: 變得更糟、更嚴重、更不愉快或更困難。
items.note: The weather started to get worse in the afternoon.（下午天氣開始變差。）
I exchanged some money for Vietnamese dong.（我換了一些越南盾。）

items.chinese: 越南中部的重要城市與港口。
items.note: Da Nang is a popular tourist city.（峴港是熱門的觀光城市。）
The center of Vietnam has beautiful beaches.（越南中部有美麗的海灘。）

items.chinese: 有保護外框的燈具，常以紙或玻璃製成，多用於裝飾。
items.note: The streets are full of beautiful lanterns.（街道上掛滿了美麗的燈籠。）

items.chinese: 經濟成長較低、現代設施較少的區域。
items.note: Tourism helps less developed areas grow.（觀光業幫助較不發達的地區發展。）
Bangkok is a busy and exciting city.（曼谷是個繁忙又充滿活力的城市。）

items.chinese: 位於歐洲西南部的國家。
items.note: I want to travel around Spain.（我想環遊西班牙。）

items.chinese: 西歐國家，以藝術、美食和歷史聞名。
items.note: France is famous for its food and culture.（法國以美食和文化聞名。）

items.chinese: 南歐國家，以歷史、藝術和美食聞名。
items.note: Many tourists visit Italy every year.（每年都有很多遊客造訪義大利。）
Belgium is famous for chocolate and waffles.（比利時以巧克力和鬆餅聞名。）

items.chinese: 位於歐洲北部的國家，包括丹麥、芬蘭、冰島、挪威、瑞典。
items.note: Nordic countries have a high quality of life.（北歐國家的生活品質很高。）
I like to travel light when I go abroad.（我出國時喜歡輕裝旅行。）

items.chinese: 用來消費並事後付款的塑膠卡片。
items.note: You can pay by credit card here.（這裡可以刷信用卡付款。）
Don’t forget your swimming suit.（別忘了帶泳衣。）

items.chinese: 幫手機或電池充電的設備。
items.note: I forgot to bring my phone charger on the trip.（我旅行時忘了帶手機充電器。）
I checked my packed stuff before leaving.（我出發前檢查了打包好的行李。）

items.chinese: 北歐國家，以峽灣和自然景觀聞名。
items.note: Norway has amazing natural scenery.（挪威有令人驚豔的自然風光。）
Copenhagen is clean and beautiful.（哥本哈根乾淨又美麗。）

items.chinese: 以手工方式慢慢將熱水沖過咖啡粉製成的咖啡。
items.note: I prefer hand brew coffee.（我比較喜歡手沖咖啡。）

items.chinese: 一種高品質的咖啡豆品種。
items.note: This café uses Arabica beans.（這家咖啡廳使用阿拉比卡咖啡豆。）

items.chinese: 去掉水分、濃稠甜膩的牛奶，常用於咖啡。
items.note: Vietnamese coffee uses condensed milk.（越南咖啡會加煉乳。）
We have a great view from the top of the building.（從大樓頂樓看出去的景色很棒。）

items.chinese: 亞洲文化中用於宗教信仰、祭拜的建築。
items.note: There are many old temples in the city.（這座城市有很多古老的寺廟。）

items.chinese: 平靜、安穩、沒有壓力或危險的生活。
items.note: He wants a simple and peaceful life.（他想要簡單平靜的生活。）

items.chinese: 不會突然改變；安全、穩定、可靠。
items.note: People hope for a stable life.（人們希望過安穩的生活。）

items.english: the amount of crowd / amount of people
items.chinese: 用於口語中，表示某個地點或活動裡的人數、人群規模。雖然 amount 原本用在不可數名詞，但這兩個片語在日常口語裡非常常見。
items.note: I was surprised by the amount of crowd at the concert last night.（昨晚演唱會的人潮之多讓我很驚訝。）

items.chinese: 大型企業在其他城市或國家設立的分部辦公室。
items.note: The company has a branch company in Asia.（這家公司在亞洲有一間分公司。）

items.chinese: 名詞：洪水；水災｜動詞：泛濫；淹沒
items.note: The small village was hit by a terrible flood last summer, and many houses were destroyed.（這個小村庄去年夏天遭遇了嚴重的水災，許多房屋都被摧毀了。）
The baker down the street makes the most delicious croissants in the neighbourhood.（街尾的這位烘焙師做的可頌是附近最好吃的。）
We need to replace our old cooker because the oven doesn’t work anymore.（我們得更換舊廚灶了，因為烤箱已經壞了。）
Our company will hold its annual meeting in April this year, in a hotel near the city centre.（我們公司今年四月將在市中心附近的飯店舉行年度大會。）

items.chinese: 名詞：進步；進展｜動詞：進步；推進
items.note: The students have made great progress in their English speaking skills after three months of practice.（經過三個月的練習，這些學生的英語口語能力有了極大的進步。）
I usually do the laundry on Sunday mornings and hang the clothes out to dry in the sun.（我通常在周日早上洗衣服，再把衣服晾在陽光下曬乾。）
She goes to the gym twice a week to keep fit, usually on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.（她一周去兩次健身房健身，通常是周二和周四晚上。）
The young scientist has made an important discovery in the field of environmental science.（這位年輕的科學家在環境科學領域有了一項重要的發現。）
The chemist at the local pharmacy told me how to take this medicine correctly.（當地藥局的藥劑師告訴我這款藥的正確服用方法。）
The cashier at the bakery gave me too much change, so I went back to return it.（麵包店的收銀員多找了我零錢，我便回去還給了她。）
The lights in our living room don’t work, so we need to call an electrician to fix them.（我們客廳的燈壞了，得找一位電工來修理。）

items.chinese: 電視節目主持人；電視主播
items.note: The young TV presenter has become very popular because of her lively and humorous hosting style.（這位年輕的電視節目主持人因活潑幽默的主持風格走紅。）
We need to replace the old windows with double-glazed ones to keep the house warm in winter.（我們得把舊窗戶換成雙層玻璃的，這樣冬天房子裡會更暖和。）

items.chinese: 獸醫（Vet 口語；Veterinarian 正式）
items.note: My cat has been sick for two days, so I will take her to the vet this afternoon.（我的貓病了兩天，今天下午我要帶牠去看獸醫。）

items.chinese: 房產中介；不動產經紀人（英式）
items.note: We asked an estate agent to help us find a suitable apartment near the school.（我們委託了一位房產中介，幫我們找一間學校附近的合適公寓。）
The sink in the kitchen is leaking, so we have to call a plumber to fix it immediately.（廚房的水龍頭漏水了，我們得馬上找水電工來修理。）
This modern museum was designed by a world-famous architect from France.（這座現代美術館是由一位法國的世界著名建築師設計的。）
We hired an interior designer to decorate our new house, and she made a perfect design plan for us.（我們聘請了一位室內設計師裝修新家，她為我們做了一份極佳的設計方案。）

items.chinese: 形容詞：脆的；清脆的；清新的｜名詞：薯片（英式）
items.note: These fresh carrots are very crisp, and they taste great when eaten raw.（這些新鮮胡蘿蔔很脆，生吃味道很棒。）

items.chinese: 動詞：擁有｜形容詞：自己的｜代名詞：自己的（東西 / 人）
items.note: She has always wanted to own a small café in the neighbourhood, and she finally made it last year.（她一直想在附近開一家小咖啡館，去年終於如願以償了。）

items.chinese: 名詞：法官；裁判｜動詞：判斷；評價；審判
items.note: It’s not fair to judge someone only by their first impression; you need to know them better.（只靠第一印象評價一個人是不公平的，你需要更瞭解他們。）
Before you sign the tenancy agreement, make sure you understand all the terms about the rent and deposit.（簽訂租賃合約前，務必瞭解所有關於租金和押金的條款。）
The local government has taken many measures to solve the problem of urban waterlogging in Wuhan in recent years.（當地政府近年來採取了許多措施，解決武漢的城市內澇問題。）
The landlord told the tenants that the rent would increase by 10% next month.（房東告訴租客們，房租將在下個月上調 10%。）

items.chinese: sentry：名詞，崗兵；崗哨｜動詞，守衛；放哨｜scout：名詞，偵查員；探員｜動詞，偵查；勘查
items.note: The soldiers stand sentry at the camp gate 24 hours a day to ensure the safety of the camp.（士兵們全天 24 小時在營地門口站崗，確保營地安全。）

items.chinese: sink：廚房水槽；洗碗池｜washbasin：衛生間洗臉盆；面盆
items.note: The water from the kitchen sink is slow to drain, so we need to clean the pipe.（廚房水槽的下水很慢，我們需要清理一下水管。）

items.chinese: 烘衣機（dryer 通用；tumble dryer 英式）
items.note: It’s raining outside, so we can’t hang the clothes out to dry—let’s use the tumble dryer instead.（外面在下雨，衣服晾不了，我們用烘衣機吧。）

items.chinese: fix the problem：解決（具體實質性）問題｜
items.note: The manager needs to handle this team conflict problem carefully, as it requires balancing the emotions of all team members.（經理需要謹慎處理這起團隊衝突問題，因為這需要平衡所有團隊成員的情緒。）

items.chinese: 萬物有靈且美（經典譯法）；大大小小的所有生物
items.note: All creatures great and small is one of my favourite books, as it tells many warm stories about animals and vets.（《萬物有靈且美》是我最喜歡的書之一，裡面講述了許多關於動物和獸醫的溫暖故事。）

items.chinese: 免費巴士乘坐；免費巴士行程
items.note: Students can get a free bus ride with their student ID cards.（學生憑學生證可免費乘坐巴士。）
We often watch films together on Friday nights.（我們經常在週五晚上一起看電影。）

items.chinese: 激勵員工；調動員工積極性
items.note: The manager uses praise and opportunities to motivate staff.（這位經理用表揚和機會來激勵員工。）
Please let me know your available time for the meeting.（請告知我你參加會議的空閒時間。）
I need to make an appointment with the dentist because my tooth hurts.（我牙齒疼，需要和牙醫預約掛號。）
My hairdresser suggested a new hairstyle that suits me well.（我的美髮師建議了一個很適合我的新髮型。）
The company gave all employees a Christmas bonus this year.（公司今年給所有員工發了聖誕獎金。）
We spent three days exploring Amsterdam and visited the Van Gogh Museum.（我們在阿姆斯特丹遊覽了三天，還參觀了梵高博物館。）
Many tourists go to Iceland to experience its unique natural beauty.（很多遊客前往冰島體驗其獨特的自然美景。）

items.chinese: 加勒比地區；加勒比海（地區）
items.note: They spent their summer holiday on a beautiful beach in the Caribbean.（他們在加勒比地區一個美麗的海灘度過暑假。）
My colleague and I are co-developing the backend API for the Overseas Headquarters’ new platform.（我和同事正在為海外總部的新平台聯合開發後端接口。）

items.chinese: Pain in the throat（喉嚨部位的疼痛）
items.note: She has a bad sore throat, so she can’t sing in the school concert tonight.（她喉嚨很痛，所以今晚不能在學校音樂會上唱歌了。）

items.chinese: - (Adjective) In good health or condition（身體健康的；狀況不錯的）
items.note: He felt fine after the short rest, but he was fined 100 yuan for parking in the wrong place.（短暫休息後他感覺不錯，但因停車不當被罰款 100 元。）

items.chinese: To talk about something with others to exchange ideas（與他人談論某事以交換想法，討論；商議）
items.note: We will have a team meeting tomorrow to discuss how to improve our work efficiency.（我們明天將開團隊會議，討論如何提高工作效率。）

items.chinese: Causing a strong feeling of dislike or nausea（引起強烈厭惡或噁心感，令人作嘔的；令人反感的）
items.note: The food in that restaurant was cold and tasted disgusting, so we left without finishing it.（那家餐廳的食物是涼的，嘗起來令人作嘔，所以我們沒吃完就離開了。）

items.chinese: Working well without wasting time or energy（工作順利且不浪費時間或精力，高效的；能幹的）
items.note: This new machine is very efficient—it can finish the work of three old machines in half the time.（這台新機器非常高效，它能在一半時間內完成三台舊機器的工作。）

items.chinese: Help and support provided to customers（提供給客戶的幫助和支持，客戶服務；客服）
items.note: I called the store’s customer service to ask about the return policy, and they answered all my questions patiently.（我致電商店客服詢問退貨政策，他們耐心地回答了我所有的問題。）

items.chinese: - A move to a higher job or position（晉升到更高的工作或職位，晉升）
items.note: She worked hard for two years and finally got a promotion to manager; meanwhile, the store is running a big promotion this weekend.（她努力工作了兩年，終於晉升為經理；與此同時，這家商店本周末正在開展大型促銷活動。）

items.chinese: An agreement to cover loss or damage for payment（通過繳費獲得損失或損害賠償的協議，保險）
items.note: It’s important to buy health insurance to cover unexpected medical expenses.（購買健康保險以應對意外醫療費用是很重要的。）

items.chinese: A new small company started by entrepreneurs（由創業者成立的新興小公司，初創公司；創業公司）
items.note: They founded a startup company focused on green energy, and it has grown quickly in the past year.（他們創立了一家專注於綠色能源的初創公司，過去一年裡發展迅速。）

items.chinese: A joke using words with the same sound but different meanings（利用發音相同但含義不同的詞製作的笑話，諧音雙關）
items.note: The comedian used a homophonic pun in his show—he said “I’m reading a book about anti-gravity, it’s impossible to put down!”（這位喜劇演員在表演中使用了諧音雙關，他說：「我正在讀一本關於反重力的書，根本放不下！」）

items.chinese: An office with a large open space and no separate rooms（擁有大型開放空間且無單獨房間的辦公室，開放式辦公室）
items.note: Our company moved to an open-plan office last month, which makes it easier to communicate with colleagues.（我們公司上個月搬到了開放式辦公室，這讓與同事溝通變得更方便了。）

items.chinese: A separate room in an office for one or a few people（辦公室中供一人或少數人使用的單獨房間，私人辦公室）
items.note: The manager has a private office where she can hold important meetings without being disturbed.（經理有一間私人辦公室，她可以在那裡舉行重要會議而不被打擾。）

items.chinese: An office divided into separate small rooms (cells)（被劃分為單獨小房間（單元）的辦公室，單間式辦公室；單元式辦公室）
items.note: Many law firms prefer cellular offices because they offer more privacy for client meetings.（許多律師事務所更喜歡單間式辦公室，因為它們能為客戶會面提供更多私密性。）

items.chinese: A shared office space used by different people or companies（不同人或公司共用的辦公空間，聯合辦公空間）
items.note: Freelancers and remote workers often choose co-working spaces to avoid working alone at home.（自由職業者和遠程工作者經常選擇聯合辦公空間，以避免在家獨自工作。）

items.chinese: An office where people use different desks each day（人們每天使用不同辦公桌的辦公室，輪用桌辦公室）
items.note: The company introduced a hot-desking office policy to make better use of space and encourage collaboration.（這家公司推出了輪用桌辦公室政策，以更好地利用空間並鼓勵合作。）
We will plant more flowers to beautify the neighbourhood.（我們會種更多花來美化社區。）

items.chinese: 履歷；resume 作動詞時也指重新開始
items.note: I updated my resume before applying for the new position.（我在應徵新職位前更新了履歷。）
I need to modify my resume to highlight my AI projects.（我需要修改履歷，突顯我的 AI 專案。）
I want to make my resume more attractive to recruiters.（我想讓我的履歷對招募人員更有吸引力。）
I don't want to exaggerate my experience during the interview.（我不想在面試時誇大自己的經歷。）
I enjoy watching anime in my free time.（我空閒時喜歡看動漫。）
A regular gym offers a wider variety of equipment.（一般健身房提供種類更多的器材。）
I have an interview for an AI engineering position next week.（我下週有一場 AI 工程師職位的面試。）
Many companies hold campus placement interviews every year.（很多公司每年都會舉辦校園徵才面試。）

items.english: interview for a place at university
items.note: She is preparing for an interview for a place at university.（她正在準備大學入學面試。）

items.chinese: 節目；計畫；美式 program 也指電腦程式
items.note: This training program is open to new employees.（這個培訓計畫開放給新進員工參加。）
We celebrated our team's success after the product launch.（產品上市後，我們慶祝了團隊的成功。）

items.chinese: 維持／娛樂或招待／娛樂活動
items.note: We maintain good relationships with our clients.（我們和客戶維持良好的關係。）
Our products use AMD chips, and I want to work in the semiconductor industry.（我們的產品使用 AMD 晶片，而我想在半導體產業工作。）
I sometimes confuse similar English expressions.（我有時會把相似的英文說法搞混。）
The interview will be broadcast live.（這場訪談將會現場直播。）

items.chinese: 發行、上映／推出產品或服務
items.note: We plan to launch the new software next month.（我們計畫下個月推出新軟體。）
We need to understand what our competitors offer.（我們需要了解競爭對手提供什麼。）
